newsitem.title: UK: Half UK fund managers see market peak a year off.
newsitem.headline: Half UK fund managers see market peak a year off.

text.p: Almost half of UK investment fund managers believe the London stock market will run higher for some time yet, but their dealers reckon the top is in sight, a survey showed on Tuesday.

The 1997 Reuters survey of UK larger company investment research, sales and trading, compiled by Tempest Consultants, showed that 47.67 percent of fund managers believe the UK market will peak in over 12 months time as against 24.42 percent who saw the peak as between now and three months away.
But among fund managers' dealers, 44 percent saw the top as less than three months away, with just 28 percent looking for the market to peak in over a year.

The 596 brokers' analysts polled were more evenly split, perhaps reflecting their differing sectoral interests. Some 21.48 percent put the peak at beween now and three months, 27.01 percent at beween four and six months, and 28.52 percent at over 12 months.
Full results of the survey are due for release at 1215 GMT on Tuesday.
